 ServiceNow Earnings Miss Amid Acquisitions, Revenue Beats 
 Licensing 
 REINHARDT KRAUSE 
 Updated 04:29 PM ET 10/28/2026
 ServiceNow (NOW) stock tumbled late Wednesday after the enterprise software maker reported third-quarter earnings that missed consensus estimates amid acquisitions. Meanwhile, revenue and key financial metrics came in above expectations. ServiceNow earnings for the quarter ended Sept. 30 rose 5% year-over-year to $1 per share, the software maker said.
